name: Potok Globovnica

en.name: The creek Globovnica
en.description: The creek Globovnica flows into the lake Radehova and the fish migrate there on the regular basis. It is home to some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

description: Potok Globovnica se izliva v jezero Radehova, kamor ribe tudi migrirajo. Potok Globovnica je naseljen s kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amura, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.

passes.name: Smuč in ščuka (samo ujemi in spusti)

name: Jezero Radehova

en.name: The lake Radehova
en.description: The lake Radehova is a cozy lake for recreational fishing. The creek Globovnica flows into it. The lake is inhabited with some first class specimens ( some over 60 kg) of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

description: Jezero Radehova je prijetno jezero za športni ribolov v katerega se steka potok Globovnica. Naseljen je s kapitalnimi primerki soma (tudi preko 60 kg), krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.

name: Jezero Sveta Trojica
subtitle: Gradiško jezero

en.name: The lake Sveta Trojica
en.subtitle: the lake Gradiško jezero
en.description: The creek Velka flows into the lake Sveta Trojica ( the lake Gradiško jezero). The mouth of the creek is the most ideal place to fish; some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish swim there.

description: V jezero Sveta Trojica ali Gradiškem jezeru se steka potok Velka. Najbolj loven je ravno izliv potoka v jezero, kjer plavajo številni kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter številne jate ribjega drobiža.

code: Pesnica, Svečniški, Dobrenjski, Cirknica, Gačniški, Vrtički, Jakobski
name: Reka Pesnica s pritoki

en.name: The river Pesnica with tributaries
en.description: The river Pesnica with tributaries is - in its upper part, from the state border in Jurij to the railroad viaduct in Pesnica- a salmonid-cyprinid river meant for recreational fishing and is home to brown trouts, rainbow trouts, common nases, chubs,common daces, common roaches, bleaks and other smallfish.

description: Reka Pesnica s pritoki je v zgornjem delu, od meje v Juriju do železniškega viadukta v Pesnici, salmonidna-ciprinidna športno ribolovna reka naseljena s potočno postrvjo, šarenko, podustjo, klenom, kleničom, rdečeoko, zelenika in drugim ribjim drobižom.

name: Potok Velka

en.name: The creek Velka
en.description: The creek Velka is tributary of the lake Sveta Trojica. Both districts are inhabitated with some first class specimens of catfish, carp, grass carp, pike, zander, common bream, silver bream, common roach, bleak and smallfish.

description: Potok Velka je pritok jezera Sveta Trojica oba revirja sta naseljena s kapitalnimi primerki soma, krapa, amurja, ščuke, smuča, ploščiča, androge, rdečooke, zelenike ter drobiža.
